notes: Four printed columns are mapped to three-month and nine-month year-to-date periods, including prior-year comparatives.
Net income is reported as a single line, without a separate attribution line.
Cash flow statement columns cover nine months ended September 26, 2026 and September 27, 2025; periods are year-to-date.

Capital expenditure is shown as positive cash spent per field convention. Investing cash flow includes continuing and discontinued operations; financing cash flow reflects the reported continuing operations subtotal because no discontinued financing subtotal is shown.

Nine-month columns are labeled YTD; segment revenue and operating income lines are presented for Data Center, Client and Gaming, Embedded, and All other. All other revenue is not printed as a separate quantified line.
FY2025, FY2024, and FY2023 refer to years ended December 27, 2025, December 28, 2024, and December 30, 2023, respectively.
The filing's income tax provision (benefit) includes negative values for benefits.
The filing reports no non-controlling interests line; total liabilities derived from total liabilities and equity less stockholders' equity.
FY2025 property and equipment purchases are shown in both continuing and discontinued investing activities; capital expenditure rows use the continuing-activities line only.
